description: This file defines classes and methods related to the 'mount' command in a kickstart configuration, including data structures for mount points and the command parser/handler.

classes.name: F27_MountData
classes.description: Data class representing a mount point configuration, including device, mount point, format, and options.

classes.name: F27_Mount
classes.description: Represents the 'mount' command in kickstart, including parsing, string representation, and data handling.

methods.name: F27_MountData.__init__
methods.description: Initializes mount data with parameters like device, mount point, format, reformat flag, and options.

methods.name: F27_MountData._getArgsAsStr
methods.description: Constructs a string of arguments representing the mount data.

methods.name: F27_MountData.__str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the mount data.

methods.name: F27_Mount.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the mount command object, including parser and mount points.

methods.name: F27_Mount.__str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the mount command with its mount points.

methods.name: F27_Mount._getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns the option parser for the mount command.

methods.name: F27_Mount.parse
methods.description: Parses command line arguments to populate mount command data.

methods.name: F27_Mount.dataList
methods.description: Returns the list of mount points.

methods.name: F27_Mount.dataClass
methods.description: Returns the data class associated with the mount command.
